name: Hover Image Nav
description: Full-screen editorial menu of large numbered text links. Hovering a link shows a floating preview image that follows the cursor while the list drifts vertically with the mouse.
contents: List of large numbered links separated by hairline dividers
behavior: Preview image fades and scales in on link hover and follows the cursor
Link list slides vertically in response to the mouse Y position
Hovered link brightens, turns italic and shows a vertical accent line
Preview is hover only, links remain tappable on touch
editableByProps: Link labels, hrefs and preview images

needsCodeEdit.where: @import line and .nav-root, .nav-index, .nav-eyebrow rules in the style block

needsCodeEdit.change: Change preview image size or shape
needsCodeEdit.where: style object on the img element

fixed: Loads Cormorant Garamond and DM Mono from Google Fonts
Listens to window mousemove for the list drift, removed on unmount
